resources.string: Entries appear here when someone tries to unlock the phone and fails.
To detect failed unlock attempts, BoopLock must be a device administrator. This is the only Android API that provides this information to non-system apps.
Camera permission is missing. Without it, no photo can be taken when an attempt is detected.
Notification permission is missing. Without it, you will not see an alert about a detected attempt.
Could not open the device administrator screen.
Could not open battery settings. Find the app manually in Settings.
Battery optimization is ON for BoopLock. On Samsung One UI, the system may block background processes and broadcasts. Disable optimization for the app to work reliably.
The alert notification channel is BLOCKED in system settings. This is the most common cause of missing alerts on Samsung One UI. Unblock it to receive notifications.
BoopLock needs administrator status solely to listen for \"failed unlock attempt\" events. The app CANNOT and WILL NOT erase, lock, or encrypt the device.
System-required notification while taking a photo.
Alert about a detected unlock attempt.
Someone tried to unlock your device! Tap to view.
All saved entries and photos will be deleted.
The entry and photo will be deleted.
Show alert after successful unlock if an attempt was detected.
Enable or disable BoopLock as device administrator.
